The '''Office of Analysis''' was a government agency of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]] worked in the Office of Analysis at some point before [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], achieving enough success to be rewarded with promotions.
